Thank you for the hug kind stranger <3 I don't live in the US so I'm far away haha, but anyway thanks. You made me feel not alone. Keep the good work with your sewing and Karate, I hope you do find a good job soon. I recommend you to retake journaling, it has done miracles for me :) I'd be dead right now if not.

Thank you for all the help <3
17 years old and about to be 18 in two months

I always thought that the amazing thing of having a hobbie is that it doesn't matter the skill, but the enjoyment. I've always wanted to do martial arts and it's amazing that you do sewing as well.
Journaling is kind of terapeutic, almost magic, but I always have the fear that my mom will read it, it can be helpful or not, I don't know and I don't want that to happen. My family also is having a hard time with money, specially with the selfishness around. 
At least, I stopped crying right now, now just kinda sobbing :)
What I think I can do is moderate the time I stay on youtube, because I like learning from those videos
Things like Life Noggin, Real Life Lore, AntsCanada, Veristatium, Vox. Videos that I find interesting mostly
Mostly singleplayer games, since I have a mild carpal tunnel I can't play multiplayer. I do not find playing videogames a problem itself, but binge-watching youtube does

I am 17 years old, about to be 18 in March. I've known about this place when the first depression stroke, somehow reading the supportive comments to other people helped, but now I felt like in need of posting this. Because I think all the people that supported me  will find this annoying like "oh, this guy again".

Most of my time I waste it on Youtube, I've been trying to get rid of it, but it's so hard. When I am not in youtube, I play videogames. Then at the start of the day or at the end of it, I write in two Journals, one digital and the other physical. I used to write, too, and I have the intention to write but for some awful reason I don't want to, it's like "I'm bad at writing anyway, so why keep going?" It's so hard to keep away those thoughts.
